mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing temperatures around 51 degrees with a light drizzle near the Verona Public Library.

In city news, the Plan Commission meets December 7th to review project documents for the Sub-Zero facility at Liberty Business Park. Additionally, the city is reminding residents to subscribe to the digital newsletter for ongoing updates on public works and city projects.

There is plenty to do in our community. We have yoga today at Insight Wellness and the ART House 360 events tonight. Looking ahead, Hop Haus hosts trivia tomorrow, and we have live music starting tomorrow at Bailey's Run Vineyard.
In our weekly report, on October 25th, officers arrested a 40-year-old Verona man for an O W I after finding his vehicle stopped in an intersection.
For dessert lovers, today's flavor is the delicious Chocolate Covered Strawberry. The Verona location is currently open and serving until 10:00 PM, so make sure to stop by soon.
